title: TOEIC – Kiểm tra chất lượng sản phẩm
prompt:
Write ONE sentence about the picture using BOTH given words or phrases. You may change their forms. (inspector / before)

Yêu cầu: Nêu một hành động có thể quan sát được và mốc trước khi đóng gói.
image_description: In a bright electronics factory, an inspector wearing safety glasses examines the screen of a tablet at a workbench. Several uncovered tablets and empty cardboard packaging boxes are arranged beside her.
sample_answer: The inspector is examining a tablet before it is packed into a box.
tips_md: **Mẹo TOEIC Picture:** Dùng hiện tại tiếp diễn cho hành động đang diễn ra. Sau *before*, có thể dùng mệnh đề bị động *it is packed* để chỉ bước tiếp theo trong quy trình. Không tự kết luận thiết bị đã đạt kiểm định.

title: TOEIC – Xếp khay bánh tại tiệm
prompt:
Write ONE sentence about the picture using BOTH given words or phrases. You may change their forms. (trays / carefully)

Yêu cầu: Mô tả thao tác xếp bánh bằng trạng từ phù hợp.
image_description: A baker in an apron is sliding two metal trays of freshly baked rolls onto a cooling rack. She wears thick oven gloves, and a second rack of bread stands behind her.
sample_answer: The baker is carefully placing trays of bread on a cooling rack.
tips_md: **Mẹo vị trí trạng từ:** *Carefully* có thể đứng trước động từ chính trong thì tiếp diễn hoặc sau tân ngữ. Viết đúng một câu chứa cả *trays* và *carefully*; chi tiết giá đỡ giúp mô tả chính xác.

title: TOEIC – Bảo dưỡng bãi cỏ công viên
prompt:
Write ONE sentence based on the picture using BOTH given words. (mower / beside)

Yêu cầu: Mô tả thiết bị và vị trí trong ảnh.
image_description: A park employee pushes a lawn mower across a strip of grass beside a winding stone walkway. Several benches line the path, and orange safety cones mark the work area.
sample_answer: A park employee is pushing a lawn mower beside the stone walkway.
tips_md: **Mẹo giới từ vị trí:** *Beside* nghĩa là ở bên cạnh và thường đi ngay trước cụm danh từ chỉ địa điểm. Dùng *is pushing* vì thao tác hiện ra trong ảnh. Tránh nhầm *beside* với *besides*.

title: TOEIC – Bảo trì pin mặt trời
prompt:
Write ONE sentence about the picture using BOTH given words. (technician / roof)

Yêu cầu: Diễn đạt hành động có thể nhìn thấy trên mái nhà.
image_description: A technician wearing a helmet and a safety harness kneels beside a row of solar panels on a flat commercial roof. He is wiping one panel with a long-handled cleaning tool.
sample_answer: A technician is cleaning a solar panel on the roof of a commercial building.
tips_md: **Mẹo chọn động từ:** Ảnh cho thấy thao tác lau chùi, nên dùng *is cleaning* thay cho suy đoán *is repairing*. Dùng *on the roof* để mô tả địa điểm và kiểm tra mạo từ trước *technician*.

title: TOEIC – Lên tàu tại nhà ga
prompt:
Write ONE sentence about the picture using BOTH given words. (passengers / board)

Yêu cầu: Mô tả hành động của một nhóm người.
image_description: At a covered railway platform, several passengers with small suitcases are stepping through the open doors of a stopped commuter train. A platform attendant stands near the doorway.
sample_answer: Several passengers are boarding a train with their suitcases.
tips_md: **Mẹo động từ:** *Board* có thể nhận trực tiếp tân ngữ *a train* mà không cần *onto*. Chủ ngữ *passengers* là số nhiều nên dùng *are boarding*. Không đoán điểm đến của đoàn tàu.

title: TOEIC – Sắp xếp mẫu trong phòng thí nghiệm
prompt:
Write ONE sentence using BOTH given words or phrases. (samples / in a row)

Yêu cầu: Miêu tả cách sắp xếp vật dụng trên bàn.
image_description: In a laboratory, a researcher in a white coat places capped glass sample tubes in a straight line on a clean bench. A notebook and a small tray sit nearby.
sample_answer: The researcher is arranging the samples in a row on the laboratory bench.
tips_md: **Mẹo cụm từ cố định:** Giữ nguyên *in a row* để mô tả các mẫu được xếp thành hàng. Dùng *arranging* hoặc *placing* đều tự nhiên. Tránh suy đoán các ống chứa hóa chất gì.

title: TOEIC – Pha đồ uống tại quán cà phê
prompt:
Write ONE sentence based on the picture using BOTH given words. (pour / cup)

Yêu cầu: Mô tả một thao tác pha chế chính xác.
image_description: Behind a café counter, a barista holds a small metal pitcher and pours steamed milk into a ceramic cup of coffee. The cup rests on a saucer next to a coffee machine.
sample_answer: The barista is pouring milk into a cup of coffee.
tips_md: **Mẹo kết hợp từ:** Cấu trúc tự nhiên là *pour something into something*. Dùng *is pouring* để thể hiện hành động đang tiếp diễn. Chú ý *a cup of coffee* thay vì *a coffee cup* nếu muốn nói đến thức uống.

title: TOEIC – So sánh ghế trong phòng trưng bày
prompt:
Write ONE sentence about the picture using BOTH given words. (customer / compare)

Yêu cầu: Nêu việc khách hàng đang làm với hai sản phẩm.
image_description: A customer stands in a furniture showroom holding two price tags, one attached to a blue office chair and the other to a black office chair. She looks back and forth between the chairs.
sample_answer: A customer is comparing the prices of two office chairs.
tips_md: **Mẹo động từ:** Dùng *compare the prices of* hoặc *compare two products*. Việc khách cầm hai thẻ giá hỗ trợ ý so sánh giá. Không đưa ra quyết định mua hàng khi ảnh chưa thể hiện.

title: TOEIC – Thay đèn trần
prompt:
Write ONE sentence about the picture using BOTH given words. (ladder / replace)

Yêu cầu: Sử dụng mệnh đề chỉ mục đích nếu phù hợp.
image_description: An electrician stands on a stepladder in an office hallway, holding a new light fixture next to an open ceiling fitting. A toolbox is on the floor below.
sample_answer: An electrician is standing on a ladder to replace a ceiling light.
tips_md: **Mẹo mục đích:** *To replace* là động từ nguyên mẫu chỉ mục đích. Giữ cả hai từ khóa trong cùng một câu. Ảnh có đèn mới nên mô tả việc thay đèn là hợp lý.

title: TOEIC – Hướng dẫn tham quan bảo tàng
prompt:
Write ONE sentence using BOTH given words or phrases. (guide / pointing at)

Yêu cầu: Mô tả tương tác giữa người hướng dẫn và khách.
image_description: A museum guide stands beside a large model of an old sailing ship, pointing at its sails while four visitors listen and look toward the display.
sample_answer: The museum guide is pointing at the sails of a ship model.
tips_md: **Mẹo cụm động từ:** *Point at* nhấn mạnh đối tượng được chỉ vào; giữ dạng *pointing at* như từ khóa. Không suy đoán lời thuyết minh của hướng dẫn viên.

title: TOEIC – Kiểm tra phanh xe đạp
prompt:
Write ONE sentence about the picture using BOTH given words. (mechanic / inspect)

Yêu cầu: Viết câu về thao tác kiểm tra thiết bị.
image_description: Inside a bicycle workshop, a mechanic crouches beside a bicycle mounted on a repair stand. He holds a flashlight close to the front brake, and several hand tools lie on a nearby tray.
sample_answer: The mechanic is inspecting the front brake of a bicycle.
tips_md: **Mẹo phân biệt ý nghĩa:** *Inspect* nghĩa là kiểm tra kỹ, không đồng nghĩa với việc đã sửa xong. Dùng thì hiện tại tiếp diễn cho thao tác đang diễn ra và nêu rõ bộ phận *front brake*.

title: TOEIC – Chất bưu kiện lên xe giao hàng
prompt:
Write ONE sentence based on the picture using BOTH given words. (parcels / into)

Yêu cầu: Mô tả hướng di chuyển của các kiện hàng.
image_description: A courier in a reflective vest is lifting two small parcels from a handcart into the open back of a delivery van. Other boxes have already been stacked inside the vehicle.
sample_answer: The courier is loading parcels into the back of a delivery van.
tips_md: **Mẹo giới từ:** *Into* diễn tả chuyển động vào bên trong, khác với *in* chỉ vị trí. Cụm *load parcels into a van* tự nhiên trong ngữ cảnh giao nhận hàng.

title: TOEIC – Chuẩn bị hỗ trợ người tham dự
prompt:
Read the email and write a reply of at least 80 words. Address all three questions.

From: Hannah Brooks, Conference Organizer
Subject: Accessibility for Thursday's workshop

Two participants have asked about step-free access. Does your building have an elevator? Where can our driver drop them off? Could someone meet them at the entrance at 8:45 a.m.?

Yêu cầu: Trả lời về thang máy, điểm đón trả và người hỗ trợ tại lối vào.
sample_answer:
Dear Ms. Brooks,

Thank you for letting us know about the participants' accessibility needs. Our building has an elevator beside the main reception desk, and it provides step-free access to the workshop room on the third floor.

Your driver can stop at the covered entrance on Oak Street, where the pavement is level with the doorway. Our visitor services colleague, Daniel, will meet the participants there at 8:45 a.m. and accompany them to the room. I will share your group's arrival details with him today.

Please tell me if either participant would benefit from any additional arrangements.

Best regards,
Ava Morris
Venue Coordinator
tips_md: **TOEIC Email – Trả lời đủ ý:** Gạch chân ba câu hỏi của người gửi trước khi viết. Nêu vị trí thang máy, địa điểm xe dừng và tên người đón kèm giờ. Cấu trúc *step-free access* và *will meet ... at* giúp thông tin rõ ràng, lịch sự.

title: TOEIC – Làm rõ sai lệch hóa đơn
prompt:
Read the email and write a reply of at least 80 words. Address all requests.

From: Grace Kim, Accounts Payable
Subject: Invoice 4162

Invoice 4162 lists 18 training manuals, but our receiving record shows only 16. Please check how many were dispatched, tell us whether two more will arrive, and advise if we should pay the invoice now.

Yêu cầu: Xác nhận số lượng đã giao, cách xử lý hai cuốn còn thiếu và đề xuất thanh toán.
sample_answer:
Dear Ms. Kim,

Thank you for flagging the difference between the invoice and your receiving record. I checked the warehouse dispatch log and confirmed that 16 manuals were shipped in the first box. The remaining two were left out because the first package reached its weight limit.

We have arranged a separate shipment for the two missing manuals, which is expected to reach your office on Monday. I have attached the updated delivery note for your reference. Please hold payment until all 18 manuals have arrived. We will then confirm the invoice total and due date together.

I appreciate your careful review and apologize for the inconvenience.

Kind regards,
Priya Shah
Order Support
tips_md: **TOEIC Email – Số liệu:** Trích lại đúng số 18 và 16 để tránh nhầm. Phân biệt *were shipped* với *are expected to arrive* vì hai mốc đã xảy ra và dự kiến. Cho hướng xử lý hóa đơn rõ ràng mà không bỏ qua hàng thiếu.

title: TOEIC – Duyệt bản thử biển chỉ dẫn
prompt:
Read the email and write a reply of at least 80 words. Respond to the three points.

From: Marco Silva, Print Studio
Subject: Lobby signs proof

We can print the new lobby signs on Friday. Have you checked the English and Vietnamese text? Do you prefer matte or glossy material? Can we receive final approval by Wednesday noon?

Yêu cầu: Xác nhận kiểm tra ngôn ngữ, chọn chất liệu và chốt hạn phê duyệt.
sample_answer:
Dear Mr. Silva,

Thank you for sending the lobby sign proofs. Our communications team has checked both the English and Vietnamese text. We found one spelling error in the Vietnamese direction to the meeting rooms, and I have marked the correction on the attached proof.

Please use a matte finish for all signs. It should be easier for visitors to read under the bright lights in our entrance hall. Once your designer sends the corrected version, I can review it on Tuesday afternoon and provide final approval by Wednesday at 11 a.m.

Would you please confirm that this schedule still allows printing to begin on Friday?

Best regards,
Linh Dao
Office Operations
tips_md: **TOEIC Email – Duyệt thiết kế:** Nêu tình trạng soát lỗi cụ thể, chọn một loại vật liệu với lý do thực tế và xác nhận mốc duyệt sớm hơn hạn chót. Dùng *matte finish* và *provide final approval* đúng văn cảnh.

title: TOEIC – Phương án dự phòng khi trời mưa
prompt:
Read the email and write a reply of at least 80 words.

From: Olivia Reed, Community Events
Subject: Saturday's outdoor demonstration

Rain is forecast for Saturday morning. Can we move the demonstration indoors? What equipment would we need to bring? When should we make the final decision?

Yêu cầu: Đề xuất không gian thay thế, thiết bị cần mang và thời điểm chốt.
sample_answer:
Dear Ms. Reed,

We can move Saturday's demonstration to the community hall if the weather makes the courtyard unsuitable. The hall seats up to 70 people and has power outlets along both side walls. I have placed a temporary hold on the room for Saturday morning.

Please bring your portable display stand, demonstration materials and two extension cords. We can provide tables, chairs, a microphone and a projector. I suggest making the final decision by 3 p.m. on Friday so that volunteers have enough time to change the signs and notify visitors.

I will keep the hall available until that deadline. Please let me know if you expect more than 70 guests.

Regards,
Noah Ellis
tips_md: **TOEIC Email – Kế hoạch dự phòng:** Thể hiện điều kiện bằng *if* và đưa mốc quyết định cụ thể. Phân biệt thiết bị đơn vị tổ chức cần mang với thiết bị nơi đăng cai cung cấp. Không cam kết sức chứa vượt khả năng đã nêu.

title: TOEIC – Hỗ trợ truy cập hội thảo trực tuyến
prompt:
Read the email and write a reply of at least 80 words. Cover the three requests.

From: Elliot Price, Training Participant
Subject: Webinar access next week

I have registered for the online training. When will I receive the joining link? Will captions be available? Is there a way to test my microphone before the session starts?

Yêu cầu: Thông tin đường dẫn, phụ đề và bước thử thiết bị.
sample_answer:
Dear Mr. Price,

Thank you for registering for next week's webinar. We will email the joining link and a calendar invitation to all participants two days before the session. Please check your spam folder if the message has not arrived by Wednesday afternoon.

Live English captions will be available through the meeting platform. You can switch them on using the Captions button after joining. We will open the online room 20 minutes early, and a member of our support team will help participants check their microphones and speakers. You may also use the platform's audio test in advance.

We look forward to welcoming you to the training.

Best regards,
Emily Park
Learning Team
tips_md: **TOEIC Email – Hướng dẫn:** Chuyển từng câu hỏi thành một thông tin có thể hành động được. Dùng tương lai *will email* cho việc gửi đường dẫn và *will be available* cho tính năng phụ đề. Phân biệt microphone với speaker.

title: TOEIC – Xác nhận hình thức phỏng vấn
prompt:
Read the email and write a reply of at least 80 words. Answer every question.

From: Sophie Grant, Job Applicant
Subject: Interview next Tuesday

Thank you for the interview invitation. Will the interview take place online or at your office? How long should I allow? Do I need to prepare a presentation or bring a portfolio?

Yêu cầu: Nêu hình thức, thời lượng và tài liệu cần chuẩn bị.
sample_answer:
Dear Ms. Grant,

Thank you for confirming your interest in the project coordinator position. Your interview will take place at our office next Tuesday at 10 a.m. Please check in at reception on the ground floor. We expect the discussion to last approximately 45 minutes, although you may wish to allow an additional 15 minutes for arrival and questions.

You do not need to prepare a presentation. However, please bring a portfolio or two examples of projects you have helped organize. Digital copies on your laptop are perfectly acceptable. The interview panel will focus on planning, communication and teamwork.

Please contact me if you need directions or any adjustments to the arrangements.

Sincerely,
Rachel Ford
Recruitment
tips_md: **TOEIC Email – Tuyển dụng:** Trả lời từng câu hỏi với thời gian và cách chuẩn bị cụ thể. Dùng *approximately* cho thời lượng ước tính. Cấu trúc *do not need to* và *please bring* giúp phân biệt điều bắt buộc và điều được khuyến nghị.

title: TOEIC – Tạm dừng gói giao thực phẩm
prompt:
Read the email and write a reply of at least 80 words.

From: Isabel Wong, Customer
Subject: Weekly fruit box

I will be away for three weeks starting December 7. Can you pause my weekly delivery? Will I be charged while it is paused? Please tell me when deliveries will start again.

Yêu cầu: Xác nhận tạm dừng, chính sách tính phí và ngày giao lại.
sample_answer:
Dear Ms. Wong,

Thank you for contacting us about your weekly fruit box. I have scheduled a pause for the deliveries due on December 7, 14 and 21. You will not be charged for those three weeks because your subscription is billed only for boxes that are dispatched.

Your regular deliveries will resume on December 28, using the address and delivery time currently saved in your account. We will send a reminder three days before that date, and you can make changes through your account page if your travel plans change.

Please reply if you would like to extend the pause. We hope you enjoy your trip.

Kind regards,
Owen Price
Customer Support
tips_md: **TOEIC Email – Ngày và phí:** Kiểm tra ba ngày tạm dừng và ngày khôi phục sao cho nhất quán với yêu cầu ba tuần. Nêu rõ có hay không tính phí, tránh câu mơ hồ như *charges may change*. Dùng *resume on* để nói ngày bắt đầu lại.

title: TOEIC – Chuẩn bị kiểm kê vật tư
prompt:
Read the email and write a reply of at least 80 words. Include all requested details.

From: Benjamin Clarke, Finance Officer
Subject: End-of-month stocktake

We need to count office supplies on the last working day of the month. Which two staff members can assist? What time should counting begin? How will you prevent new items from being issued during the count?

Yêu cầu: Đề cử nhân sự, thời điểm bắt đầu và cách khóa luồng cấp phát.
sample_answer:
Dear Mr. Clarke,

I can assign Mai Nguyen and David Chen to assist with the end-of-month stocktake. Both have worked with the supply register before and are available on the last working day of the month.

I suggest starting at 2 p.m., after the regular stationery requests have been completed. We will notify all departments that supplies cannot be collected between 2 and 4 p.m. During that period, the storage room will remain locked except when the counting team is present. Any urgent request will be recorded and fulfilled after the final totals are checked.

Please let me know whether you need us to prepare a printed count sheet in advance.

Best regards,
Tuan Le
Administration
tips_md: **TOEIC Email – Quy trình:** Nêu hai tên, một giờ bắt đầu và cơ chế ngăn giao dịch trong lúc kiểm kê. Các cụm *stocktake*, *supply register*, *urgent request* phù hợp ngôn ngữ văn phòng. Dùng *will remain locked* cho quy định tạm thời.

title: TOEIC – Truy xuất bằng chứng giao hàng
prompt:
Read the email and write a reply of at least 80 words.

From: Fatima Ali, Retail Manager
Subject: Missing display units

Our branch has not located the six display units listed as delivered yesterday. Can you confirm the delivery location, tell us who signed for them, and send any document that will help us trace the shipment?

Yêu cầu: Nêu vị trí giao, người ký nhận và chứng từ truy xuất.
sample_answer:
Dear Ms. Ali,

I have checked the courier's delivery record for the six display units. According to the record, the shipment was delivered to your building's rear receiving entrance at 3:20 p.m. yesterday. The signature field contains the name J. Carter, listed as a member of the receiving team.

I have attached a copy of the delivery confirmation showing the timestamp and the package count. Would you please check with the receiving team and the temporary storage area behind the loading bay? If the units are still missing by this afternoon, I will request a formal trace from the courier.

I will keep you updated on any new information.

Regards,
Aisha Rahman
Logistics Support
tips_md: **TOEIC Email – Độ chính xác:** Dùng *according to the record* khi dữ liệu dựa vào chứng từ thay vì điều mình chứng kiến. Ghi rõ vị trí, thời điểm và tên người ký. Đưa bước truy tìm tiếp theo mà không suy đoán lỗi thuộc về ai.

title: TOEIC – Điều chỉnh suất ăn sự kiện
prompt:
Read the email and write a reply of at least 80 words. Respond to all requests.

From: Natalie Evans, Catering Manager
Subject: Friday team lunch

Your original order is for 32 meals. We have received a request for four gluten-free meals. Does the total meal count stay the same? Which dishes should we substitute? Can you approve the revised order by 4 p.m. today?

Yêu cầu: Xác nhận tổng số suất, món thay thế và mốc duyệt.
sample_answer:
Dear Ms. Evans,

Thank you for checking the dietary requirements for Friday's team lunch. The total remains 32 meals. Please replace four of the standard pasta portions with gluten-free rice bowls containing grilled vegetables and chicken. That will leave 28 standard pasta meals and four gluten-free meals.

Please prepare the gluten-free portions separately and label each container clearly so that our team can distribute them correctly. I have reviewed the revised order and approve the quantities and substitutions described above before today's 4 p.m. deadline. Could you send the updated order summary for our records?

Thank you for accommodating the changes.

Best regards,
Samira Khan
Office Events
tips_md: **TOEIC Email – Kiểm soát số lượng:** Tổng 28 + 4 phải bằng 32. Dùng *replace ... with ...* khi đổi món và *remains* khi số lượng không thay đổi. Khẳng định duyệt đơn một cách trực tiếp và nêu yêu cầu ghi nhãn.

title: Business English – Làm rõ phạm vi dự án
prompt:
You are a project lead. A client has asked your team to add a live dashboard to a two-week reporting project. Write a professional email of 100–150 words that acknowledges the request, explains how it affects scope and timing, and offers two practical options. Do not promise an unapproved deadline.

Yêu cầu: Xử lý yêu cầu phát sinh và đề xuất lựa chọn có thể ra quyết định.
sample_answer:
Dear Ms. Bennett,

Thank you for explaining how a live dashboard would help your managers monitor results throughout the day. I agree that it could add value to the reporting project.

Our current two-week plan covers a daily spreadsheet report and a final presentation. A live dashboard would require additional work on data connections, refresh rules and testing. We would need to review the schedule before confirming a new delivery date.

We could either complete the original reporting package as planned and scope the dashboard as a second phase, or prioritize a simple dashboard now and move some presentation work to a later milestone. Both approaches are possible, subject to agreement on the revised scope.

Could we discuss your preferred option in a short call tomorrow?

Kind regards,
Alex Morgan
Project Lead
tips_md: **Business English – Scope change:** Nhắc lại kết quả đã cam kết và chỉ ra phần công việc tăng thêm bằng danh từ cụ thể. Đưa hai phương án có hệ quả rõ ràng rồi đề nghị cuộc gọi để chốt. Dùng *subject to agreement* thay cho lời hứa vượt thẩm quyền.

title: Business English – Báo cáo rủi ro tiến độ
prompt:
You manage a product launch. The packaging supplier has not delivered test samples, and approval is due in five working days. Write an email of 100–150 words to your director that states the facts, describes the impact, explains the action already taken and asks for one decision. Keep the tone calm and accountable.

Yêu cầu: Báo cáo vướng mắc có dữ kiện, phương án và yêu cầu quyết định rõ.
sample_answer:
Dear Ms. Chen,

I would like to flag a risk to the product launch schedule. The supplier was due to send packaging test samples on Monday, but we have not received them as of this morning. Our design team needs the physical samples before it can approve the final packaging, and that approval is scheduled in five working days.

I contacted the supplier yesterday and requested a confirmed dispatch date and tracking details. They have acknowledged the request but have not provided a delivery commitment. Meanwhile, we have prepared a checklist so testing can begin immediately when the samples arrive.

Would you authorize us to obtain a small backup sample batch from our approved secondary supplier if we have no confirmed dispatch by tomorrow noon?

Regards,
Jordan Lee
Launch Manager
tips_md: **Business English – Escalation:** Tách sự thật đã kiểm chứng, tác động tiến độ và bước đang làm. Dùng *risk to the schedule*, *confirmed dispatch date* và câu hỏi yêu cầu đúng một quyết định. Tránh đổ lỗi hoặc dùng từ chắc chắn khi chưa có lịch giao.

title: Business English – Gửi biên bản và đầu việc
prompt:
You have just finished a cross-functional meeting about updating an online help center. Write a follow-up email of 110–160 words with the decision taken, three named action owners and deadlines, one unresolved question, and a request for corrections to the summary.

Yêu cầu: Ghi lại quyết định, trách nhiệm, thời hạn và vấn đề còn mở.
sample_answer:
Hello everyone,

Thank you for today's discussion about the help center update. We agreed to publish the revised account and payment articles first, then release the remaining topics in a second batch.

As discussed, Mei will check the accuracy of the account instructions by Thursday. Daniel will update the screenshots and accessibility descriptions by Friday. Priya will review the payment articles with the support team and return her comments by Monday afternoon. I will combine the approved material and confirm the release checklist.

One question remains open. Should older article URLs redirect to the nearest updated page or to the main help center index? Please share your preference before Friday's planning call.

If I have missed a decision or assigned an action incorrectly, please reply with a correction by tomorrow at 3 p.m.

Best,
Riley
tips_md: **Business English – Meeting recap:** Ghi quyết định trước, sau đó gắn từng hành động với một người và thời hạn. Nêu một vấn đề chưa ngã ngũ như câu hỏi cụ thể. Mẫu *If I have missed...* khuyến khích sửa sai mà không gây áp lực.

title: Business English – Góp ý bản đề xuất
prompt:
A colleague has sent a draft proposal with a clear cost breakdown but no implementation timeline or success measures. Write a supportive email of 100–150 words acknowledging its strengths, suggesting two concrete additions and offering help before the client review on Tuesday.

Yêu cầu: Góp ý mang tính xây dựng với đề xuất có thể thực hiện.
sample_answer:
Hi Morgan,

Thanks for sharing the draft proposal. The cost breakdown is particularly clear, and I think the comparison between the two service packages will help the client understand the trade-offs.

Before Tuesday's review, I suggest adding a short implementation timeline with key milestones, owners and dependencies. This would show how the work could progress from approval to launch. It would also help to include two or three success measures, such as response time, user adoption and the number of support requests resolved without escalation. We can then explain how the team plans to track those measures.

If you would like, I can draft a milestone table this afternoon and review the metrics section with you tomorrow. Let me know which part would be most helpful.

Best,
Taylor
tips_md: **Business English – Feedback:** Khen một điểm cụ thể rồi nêu đúng hai khoảng trống có hướng bổ sung. Dùng *I suggest adding...* thay cho câu mệnh lệnh. Kết bằng đề nghị hỗ trợ gắn với hạn gặp khách hàng.

title: Business English – Thông báo quy trình đặt phòng
prompt:
You are the office operations coordinator. Write a clear announcement email of 110–160 words explaining a new meeting-room booking rule effective January 4. Staff must book through the shared calendar, release unused rooms after 15 minutes, and contact reception for exceptions. Include the reason, transition support and a contact point.

Yêu cầu: Viết thông báo thay đổi quy trình với hiệu lực và hướng dẫn dễ thực hiện.
sample_answer:
Hello team,

From January 4, we will use one shared calendar for all meeting-room reservations. This change should reduce double bookings and make it easier to find available space during busy periods.

Please reserve a room through the Office Rooms calendar before inviting participants. If a meeting has not started within 15 minutes of its scheduled time, release the room so another team can use it. For events requiring special equipment or an exception to these rules, contact reception before confirming your booking.

During the first week, reception will help colleagues who need assistance with the calendar. A short illustrated guide will also be available on the staff portal. Existing reservations for dates after January 4 will be transferred to the new calendar by our operations team.

Please send questions to the reception desk or reply to this email.

Thank you,
Casey Miller
Office Operations
tips_md: **Business English – Announcement:** Đặt ngày hiệu lực ở đầu, trình bày ba hành động bằng động từ trực tiếp, rồi giải thích cách hỗ trợ chuyển đổi. Dùng *release the room* để diễn đạt trả phòng cho người khác đặt; tránh thông báo mơ hồ kiểu *please cooperate*.

title: TOEIC – Luân chuyển vị trí để phát triển kỹ năng
prompt:
Do you agree or disagree with the following statement? Give reasons and specific examples to support your answer.

"Employees should occasionally work in a different department to understand how their company operates."

Yêu cầu: Viết bài luận khoảng 300 từ, nêu lập trường rõ và ví dụ thực tế.
sample_answer:
I agree that employees should sometimes spend a short period working with another department. When a company designs these exchanges carefully, workers gain a wider understanding of its operations and become better partners in their regular roles.

First, job rotation helps employees see how one team's decisions affect another. For example, a salesperson may promise a delivery date without fully understanding the warehouse's packing schedule. After spending a week alongside the logistics team, that employee would know which information to check before making a commitment to a customer. This knowledge could prevent misunderstandings and reduce the number of urgent requests sent between departments. The exchange would also help warehouse staff understand why customers sometimes need special arrangements.

Second, short rotations can reveal skills that employees would like to develop. Someone who works in administration might discover an interest in analyzing customer feedback. A temporary assignment in the research team could give that person a chance to learn how surveys are prepared and interpreted. Even if the employee returns to the same job, the new skills could improve their everyday work and support future career planning.

However, rotations should not become an extra burden. Employees need clear objectives, basic training and enough time to complete their usual responsibilities. Managers should avoid transferring people during critical deadlines. A one-week observation placement or a shared project may be more practical than switching jobs for an entire month.

In conclusion, occasional cross-department experience can improve communication and encourage professional growth. I support the idea as long as companies organize it with a clear purpose and respect the workload of each participating team.
tips_md: **TOEIC Opinion Essay – Phát triển lập luận:** Nêu hai lợi ích riêng là hiểu quy trình liên phòng ban và khám phá kỹ năng mới. Ví dụ phòng kinh doanh với kho vận chứng minh tác động cụ thể. Đoạn điều kiện triển khai tạo chiều sâu; kết luận quay lại lập trường *agree*.

title: TOEIC – Tiêu chí khen thưởng minh bạch
prompt:
Do you agree or disagree with this statement? Support your opinion with reasons and examples.

"Companies should publish clear criteria for employee recognition awards."

Yêu cầu: Viết khoảng 300 từ, thể hiện quan điểm và giải thích ảnh hưởng đến nhân viên.
sample_answer:
I strongly agree that companies should explain the criteria used for employee recognition awards. Clear standards make the process more credible and encourage people to focus on work that genuinely benefits their teams and customers.

One reason is that transparency increases trust. If an award is announced without an explanation, employees may wonder whether the winner was chosen because of personal connections or popularity. In contrast, when the company publishes criteria such as service quality, teamwork and improvement over time, people can understand what the award represents. For example, a customer support department could recognize an employee who consistently solves difficult cases while also helping new colleagues. Explaining these achievements would make the decision easier to respect.

Clear criteria also help employees improve. Suppose a technician is interested in an annual excellence award but does not know what the company values. The person may simply try to complete as many jobs as possible. A published scoring guide could show that accurate documentation and safety practices matter as much as speed. The technician could then set useful goals and ask a manager for relevant feedback.

Of course, awards cannot measure every valuable contribution perfectly. Some employees work behind the scenes, and their efforts may be less visible than sales results. Companies should therefore use several sources of evidence, allow colleagues to nominate one another and review the criteria regularly. Managers can also explain that recognition is one form of appreciation rather than the only measure of a person's worth.

Overall, publishing award criteria improves fairness and gives employees practical direction. When standards are balanced and reviewed carefully, recognition can motivate stronger performance without creating unnecessary competition.
tips_md: **TOEIC Opinion Essay – Fairness:** Dùng một đoạn cho tính minh bạch, một đoạn cho khả năng cải thiện hiệu suất, và ví dụ ngành nghề khác nhau. Phân biệt *criteria* (số nhiều) với *criterion* (số ít). Đề cập giới hạn của việc đo lường để tránh tuyệt đối hóa.

title: TOEIC – Hướng dẫn nhân viên mới bằng người cố vấn
prompt:
Do you agree or disagree with this statement? Explain your view with reasons and examples.

"Every new employee should be paired with an experienced colleague during the first month."

Yêu cầu: Viết bài khoảng 300 từ, có ví dụ và đề xuất triển khai hợp lý.
sample_answer:
I agree that new employees should have an experienced colleague to guide them during their first month. A simple mentoring arrangement can make the transition into a new workplace less confusing and help new staff contribute sooner.

First, mentors can explain everyday procedures that are difficult to learn from a handbook. A new employee may understand the company's formal policies but still be unsure how to request equipment, report an unexpected problem or find the right person to approve an expense. An experienced colleague can demonstrate these steps in the actual workplace. For instance, a new hotel receptionist might learn how to manage an early check-in request by observing a coworker handle a real situation. The learner can then practice with someone available to answer questions.

Second, mentoring encourages a sense of belonging. Starting a new job often involves meeting many unfamiliar people and understanding a different team culture. When an employee knows whom to approach for help, asking questions becomes easier. This can prevent small mistakes from turning into larger problems. The mentor may also introduce the newcomer to colleagues in other departments, making future cooperation smoother.

However, mentoring works only when both people have time for it. Managers should choose colleagues who are willing to help and reduce competing tasks when necessary. A short daily check-in during the first week, followed by weekly meetings, may be enough for many roles. New hires should also receive written information so they can review important processes independently.

In conclusion, a first-month mentoring program offers practical guidance and social support. With clear expectations and reasonable workloads, it can benefit new employees, their mentors and the wider organization.
tips_md: **TOEIC Opinion Essay – Ví dụ nghề nghiệp:** Kết hợp lợi ích học quy trình và hòa nhập tập thể. Ví dụ lễ tân khách sạn cần thể hiện mentor hướng dẫn hành động cụ thể. Khi nói điều kiện thành công, đề xuất tần suất gặp và thời gian dành cho người hướng dẫn.

title: TOEIC – Khai thác ý tưởng từ khách hàng
prompt:
Do you agree or disagree with the following statement? Support your position with examples.

"Businesses should regularly invite customers to suggest improvements to their products and services."

Yêu cầu: Viết khoảng 300 từ, phân tích lợi ích và cách xử lý phản hồi.
sample_answer:
I agree that businesses should regularly invite customers to suggest improvements. People who use a product or service every day often notice practical difficulties that employees may overlook. Their observations can help companies make better decisions.

First, customer suggestions reveal problems in real situations. A software company may believe its appointment system is easy to use because its internal tests were successful. However, customers might explain that the confirmation message does not clearly state the appointment location. Adding that information would be a small change with a significant effect on the user experience. Without asking for feedback, the company might continue receiving avoidable questions and complaints.

Second, inviting suggestions can strengthen customer relationships. When a business asks what people need and explains how their ideas are evaluated, customers feel that their experiences matter. For example, a neighborhood grocery store could survey regular shoppers about the most convenient opening hours. Even if the store cannot act on every request, publishing a summary of the results and explaining its decision would show respect for customers' time.

Businesses should nevertheless avoid treating every suggestion as a requirement. Some requests may conflict with safety standards, budgets or the needs of other users. A useful process would collect feedback through short surveys and support conversations, group repeated concerns, and test proposed changes with a small number of customers. Staff should also report what was improved and why other ideas were postponed.

In conclusion, regular customer feedback is a valuable source of practical knowledge and trust. I support seeking it actively, provided that companies evaluate suggestions fairly and communicate the results instead of promising to implement everything.
tips_md: **TOEIC Opinion Essay – Customer feedback:** Dùng một ví dụ sản phẩm số và một ví dụ dịch vụ trực tiếp để tăng tính đa dạng. Cụm *invite suggestions*, *act on feedback* và *communicate the results* tự nhiên trong văn cảnh kinh doanh. Nhấn mạnh việc chọn lọc thay vì hứa làm mọi yêu cầu.

title: TOEIC – Huấn luyện sơ cứu tại nơi làm việc
prompt:
Do you agree or disagree with the statement below? Give reasons and examples to support your view.

"All employees should receive basic first-aid training at work."

Yêu cầu: Viết khoảng 300 từ, đề cập lợi ích an toàn và tính thực tiễn.
sample_answer:
I agree that every employee should have an opportunity to learn basic first aid. Emergencies can occur in offices, shops and other workplaces, and a small amount of practical training can help colleagues respond more calmly while professional assistance is on its way.

One benefit is that employees may recognize a problem sooner. For example, if a coworker suddenly becomes unwell during a meeting, trained colleagues can alert emergency services, provide accurate information and follow the guidance they have learned. Without preparation, people may panic or waste valuable time deciding whom to contact. A short course can also explain the location of first-aid equipment and the steps for reporting an incident safely.

Training can also improve a company's overall safety culture. When employees discuss emergency procedures together, they become more aware of risks in their ordinary environment. A restaurant team might review how to respond to minor burns and how to keep walkways clear. Office staff might practice a clear communication procedure for contacting building security. These activities encourage employees to notice hazards and raise concerns before an accident occurs.

Of course, first-aid education requires time and money. Smaller companies may find it difficult to release everyone for a full day. They could offer short sessions in several groups and provide refresher training when procedures change. Courses should be delivered by qualified instructors, and staff should understand the limits of their training. Employees must be encouraged to contact emergency professionals whenever necessary.

In conclusion, basic first-aid training is a sensible investment in workplace preparedness. By organizing affordable, practical sessions and maintaining clear emergency procedures, employers can help workers respond responsibly when unexpected situations arise.
tips_md: **TOEIC Opinion Essay – Safety:** Dùng từ vựng chính xác như *first-aid equipment*, *emergency services* và *qualified instructors*. Hai luận điểm nên phân biệt phản ứng khi có sự cố với văn hóa phòng ngừa. Tránh mô tả kỹ thuật y tế chi tiết không nằm trong đề.

title: IELTS Writing Task 2 – Giờ học bắt đầu muộn hơn
prompt:
Some people believe that secondary schools should start classes later in the morning, while others think the current early schedules are more practical. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

Write at least 250 words.

Yêu cầu: Thảo luận hai phía và nêu quan điểm nhất quán.
sample_answer:
The time at which secondary school students begin their lessons is a matter of debate. Some argue that a later start would improve teenagers' daily routines, whereas others believe early schedules fit more easily into family and community life. In my view, schools should consider a modestly later start where transport and childcare arrangements allow it.

Supporters of later classes point to the difficulties many teenagers experience when they must travel to school very early. Students who are tired at the beginning of the day may struggle to concentrate during demanding subjects. Starting an hour later could make mornings less rushed and give learners more time to prepare for school. It might also reduce the pressure on families whose children face long journeys across a city. A more manageable schedule could improve the quality of the first lessons rather than simply extending the school day.

However, early starts are convenient for some households. Parents may need to drop children off before going to work, and school buses often serve several schools in sequence. Changing the timetable could create transport costs or make it harder for students to attend after-school sports, part-time work and family activities. In rural areas, long bus routes may leave little room for adjustment. It would therefore be unrealistic to impose exactly the same timetable everywhere.

I believe schools should evaluate local needs before changing their schedules. They could survey students and parents, review transport capacity and trial a later start for one term. The results should include attendance, punctuality and feedback from teachers as well as academic performance. Schools could then adapt after-school activities to any revised timetable.

In conclusion, later starts may support students' readiness to learn, but early schedules serve important practical purposes. A carefully tested local approach is preferable to a universal rule.
tips_md: **IELTS Discuss Both Views:** Hai đoạn thân bài phải trình bày đúng lập luận của từng bên trước khi nêu giải pháp riêng. Dùng các cụm *a modestly later start*, *transport capacity*, *impose a timetable* chính xác. Kết luận giữ quan điểm có điều kiện từ mở bài.

title: IELTS Writing Task 2 – Công cụ dịch tự động
prompt:
Automatic translation tools are making it easier for people who speak different languages to communicate. Do the advantages of this development outweigh its disadvantages?

Write at least 250 words.

Yêu cầu: Đánh giá hai mặt và xác định mặt nào có sức nặng lớn hơn.
sample_answer:
Automatic translation has become a common way to communicate across language barriers. It can make everyday information more accessible, although it sometimes produces inaccurate or culturally inappropriate messages. I believe its benefits outweigh its drawbacks when users understand its limitations.

The greatest advantage is that translation tools allow people to handle practical situations without waiting for professional assistance. A traveler can read a public transport notice, a small business owner can understand an initial inquiry from an overseas customer, and a newly arrived resident can explore basic information about local services. These interactions may be brief, but they help people participate in activities that would otherwise be difficult. Translation software can also support language learning by allowing students to compare different ways of expressing an idea, provided that they check the results critically.

Nevertheless, convenience can create false confidence. A translated sentence may be grammatically fluent while missing the original speaker's intention. Humor, politeness and professional terminology do not always transfer neatly between languages. Misunderstandings are particularly serious in medical, legal or safety-related contexts, where a single incorrect instruction could have significant consequences. There is also a risk that learners become dependent on the software and spend less time developing their own communication skills.

These weaknesses are important, but they can be managed through sensible use. Organizations should provide professional translation or interpretation for high-stakes information, while individuals can use automated tools for informal communication and preliminary understanding. Schools could teach students to identify uncertain wording, review multiple interpretations and ask a human speaker for clarification when needed. This approach treats the software as a helpful resource requiring judgment.

In conclusion, automatic translation opens valuable opportunities for communication and access to information. Although accuracy and overdependence remain concerns, its advantages are greater when critical decisions receive appropriate human review.
tips_md: **IELTS Advantages Outweigh Disadvantages:** Nêu rõ phán đoán mức độ trong cả mở và kết. Đoạn hạn chế dùng một tình huống rủi ro cao để tăng tính thuyết phục. Dùng *false confidence*, *high-stakes information*, *preliminary understanding* và giải pháp kiểm tra khi cần.

title: IELTS Writing Task 2 – Thiếu nhân lực y tế vùng xa
prompt:
Some rural communities find it difficult to attract and retain qualified healthcare professionals. What causes this problem, and what measures could help address it?

Write at least 250 words.

Yêu cầu: Phân tích nguyên nhân và đề xuất giải pháp tương ứng.
sample_answer:
Many rural communities struggle to maintain a stable healthcare workforce. The problem is often linked to working conditions and limited career opportunities rather than a lack of interest in serving patients. Governments and healthcare organizations can respond by improving professional support as well as daily living conditions.

One major cause is the demanding nature of rural practice. A small clinic may employ only a few doctors or nurses, leaving them responsible for a wide range of cases and long on-call periods. Limited diagnostic equipment can make their work more stressful, especially when patients need urgent transfers to larger hospitals. In addition, professionals may worry that working far from a teaching hospital will reduce their access to specialist training, research and promotion. Their families may also face fewer educational and employment options.

Financial incentives can help, but they should form only part of the solution. Authorities could offer housing assistance, travel allowances and scholarships that support graduates who choose rural placements. More importantly, clinics need reliable equipment, adequate staffing and clear referral arrangements with regional hospitals. Remote consultations with specialists could give local professionals access to advice while allowing many patients to receive routine care closer to home.

Long-term retention also depends on career development and community integration. Health services could arrange regular training visits, protected study time and opportunities to rotate through larger hospitals without losing a rural position. Local authorities could support partners seeking work and help new families find housing and schools. These practical measures would make a rural posting more sustainable rather than merely attractive for a short period.

In conclusion, rural workforce shortages arise from professional isolation, heavy workloads and personal constraints. Combining reasonable financial support with stronger clinical networks and career pathways would make it easier to recruit and retain qualified staff.
tips_md: **IELTS Causes and Solutions:** Mỗi nguyên nhân cần dẫn đến một giải pháp có thể triển khai. Đặt *professional isolation* và *career pathways* cạnh các vấn đề cơ sở vật chất để tránh chỉ bàn về lương. Giữ chủ thể giải pháp rõ như chính quyền và đơn vị y tế.

title: IELTS Writing Task 2 – Trồng thực phẩm trong thành phố
prompt:
In some cities, residents are encouraged to grow fruit and vegetables on rooftops, balconies and shared land. What are the benefits and challenges of this trend?

Write at least 250 words.

Yêu cầu: Phân tích lợi ích và thách thức của canh tác quy mô nhỏ ở đô thị.
sample_answer:
Growing food in urban spaces has attracted interest as cities look for practical ways to improve everyday living. Rooftop planters, balcony containers and shared growing areas can provide environmental and social benefits, but they also require careful planning and regular maintenance.

One advantage is that urban gardening helps residents understand where food comes from. People who grow herbs or vegetables learn how much water, space and attention different plants need. This experience may encourage more thoughtful consumption and reduce waste at home. Shared gardens can also create opportunities for neighbors to cooperate. For example, residents of an apartment complex might take turns watering a small vegetable plot and share the harvest. Such activities can strengthen relationships in buildings where people rarely meet.

Urban planting may also make some spaces more pleasant. Greenery can provide shade and improve the appearance of bare roofs and courtyards. However, these benefits depend on the design and maintenance of each project. A neglected garden may attract pests, create drainage problems or become unusable. Rooftop growing is particularly challenging because additional soil and water place weight on a building. It should therefore be assessed by qualified professionals before residents install large planting beds.

Another difficulty is unequal access. Some households have spacious balconies and spare time, while others live in crowded homes or work long hours. Community projects should offer flexible participation and avoid expecting residents to provide unpaid labor indefinitely. Local councils could help by identifying suitable shared spaces, publishing safety guidance and supporting volunteer coordinators. Schools and community centers might also provide simple training in responsible growing practices.

In conclusion, urban food growing can encourage learning, social connection and better use of space. Its challenges involve safety, resources and continuing responsibility. With realistic expectations and appropriate support, it can become a valuable addition to city life.
tips_md: **IELTS Benefits and Challenges:** Nêu lợi ích ở hai cấp cá nhân và cộng đồng, sau đó phân tích giới hạn kỹ thuật như tải trọng mái và khả năng duy trì. Không phóng đại sản lượng vườn nhỏ thành giải pháp đủ nuôi cả thành phố. Dùng *shared growing areas*, *drainage*, *flexible participation*.

title: IELTS Writing Task 2 – Biến cửa hàng trống thành không gian cộng đồng
prompt:
Some people think city authorities should temporarily convert vacant high-street shops into community spaces, such as art studios or study rooms. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

Write at least 250 words.

Yêu cầu: Nêu mức độ đồng ý và điều kiện để triển khai hiệu quả.
sample_answer:
Empty shops can make a commercial street feel neglected, particularly when several premises remain unused for long periods. I largely agree that local authorities should encourage temporary community activities in these buildings, provided that the arrangements respect property rights and have realistic operating plans.

One benefit is that short-term community use can make a street more active and welcoming. A vacant shop could host an exhibition by local artists, an after-school study room or a repair workshop. These activities would bring people into the area and might also increase visits to nearby cafés and retailers. For example, parents waiting for children at a weekend art class could use other services on the same street. Temporary projects would give residents a reason to return to a place that has lost some of its commercial activity.

Such projects could also test whether an area needs particular services. If a study room attracts many users, the council may discover demand for affordable learning space. However, converting a shop does not automatically create a successful community center. Buildings may need repairs, accessible entrances, insurance and supervision. Without funding for these essentials, an appealing idea could become expensive or unsafe. Owners may also be reluctant to offer temporary access if they expect to lease the premises commercially soon.

For these reasons, participation should be voluntary and governed by clear short-term agreements. Authorities could help match willing landlords with established local organizations and provide small grants for essential improvements. Each project should publish opening hours, responsibilities and a plan for leaving the premises when the agreement ends. Regular reviews could identify which activities attract sustained community interest.

Overall, temporary reuse can revive underused streets and provide accessible services. I support it as a flexible partnership between owners, councils and community groups rather than a permanent solution imposed on every empty shop.
tips_md: **IELTS To What Extent:** Từ *largely agree* phải được phản ánh trong toàn bài, kèm điều kiện quyền sở hữu và vận hành. Dùng ví dụ cụ thể về không gian học tập, nghệ thuật. Đoạn giải pháp trả lời trực tiếp rủi ro phát sinh ở đoạn trước.

title: IELTS Writing Task 2 – Xác minh tuổi trên mạng xã hội
prompt:
Some people believe social media platforms should require stronger age verification for young users, while others worry that these checks would create privacy problems. Discuss both views and give your opinion.

Write at least 250 words.

Yêu cầu: Thảo luận an toàn trực tuyến và quyền riêng tư, rồi nêu quan điểm.
sample_answer:
Whether social media platforms should conduct stronger age checks is increasingly debated. Supporters regard verification as a way to protect children from inappropriate services, while critics are concerned about the personal information these systems may collect. I believe age protection is important, but verification methods should minimize the amount of data stored about users.

Those in favor of stricter checks argue that age-based rules have little value if anyone can enter a false date of birth. Reliable verification could help platforms apply appropriate account settings, limit certain features and guide younger users toward safer experiences. Parents might also have more confidence that rules designed for children are being applied consistently. Without meaningful checks, platforms may struggle to distinguish younger users from adults when enforcing these protections.

However, the privacy concerns are substantial. Some verification systems ask people to upload identification documents or photographs. If such records are stored carelessly, they could expose sensitive information about users, including children. Strict checks could also exclude people who lack suitable documents or have difficulty using digital services. A policy intended to improve safety could therefore create new risks and barriers.

In my view, platforms should be required to demonstrate that their methods are proportionate to the services offered. Independent specialists could assess whether a system confirms an age category without retaining unnecessary identity details. Clear explanations, secure handling of information and accessible alternatives would be essential. Regulators should also evaluate whether verification actually improves safety rather than assuming that stronger collection of personal data always leads to better outcomes.

In conclusion, credible age checks may help protect younger users, but poorly designed systems can threaten privacy and access. I support stronger safeguards when they use limited data, undergo independent assessment and remain open to improvement.
tips_md: **IELTS Discuss Both Views – Lập luận cân bằng:** Phân biệt lợi ích thực thi quy định theo tuổi và rủi ro thu thập dữ liệu. Quan điểm cuối là ủng hộ có điều kiện, với tiêu chí *proportionate*, *data minimization* và *independent assessment*. Tránh khẳng định một công nghệ xác minh cụ thể hoàn toàn an toàn.

title: IELTS Writing Task 2 – Truy cập mở với nghiên cứu công
prompt:
Research funded by public money should be freely available to everyone. Do you agree or disagree? Give reasons and examples to support your opinion.

Write at least 250 words.

Yêu cầu: Lập luận về lợi ích tiếp cận tri thức và các giới hạn hợp lý.
sample_answer:
When taxpayers finance research, there is a strong argument that its findings should be accessible to the public. I largely agree with making publicly funded research freely available, although some materials require restrictions to protect participants, personal information or legitimate security interests.

The first advantage of open access is that it allows knowledge to reach people who cannot afford expensive subscriptions. Teachers, small businesses and researchers at less wealthy institutions may benefit from scientific findings but lack access to specialist journals. For example, a teacher developing an environmental science lesson could use openly published studies to explain how researchers collect and interpret evidence. Easier access would also allow independent specialists to examine results, question methods and build on earlier work.

A second benefit is that public availability can improve the value of research funding. Studies often require substantial investment in equipment, staff and data collection. If only a small group can read the results, opportunities for practical application may be missed. Open summaries and well-documented findings could help local organizations make informed choices. Researchers may also avoid duplicating work unnecessarily when previous methods and conclusions are easy to discover.

Nevertheless, openness must be handled responsibly. A medical study might contain information that could identify participants, while certain technical results could pose safety or security concerns. Making every raw dataset public would therefore be inappropriate. Institutions should distinguish between findings intended for broad publication and restricted materials that require additional protection. They could release anonymized data when suitable, explain the limits of access and make plain-language summaries available alongside technical papers.

In conclusion, the public should normally be able to read the results of research it has funded. Clear exceptions for privacy and safety would preserve the benefits of open knowledge while respecting the responsibilities that researchers have toward participants and society.
tips_md: **IELTS Agree/Disagree – Mức độ đồng ý:** *Largely agree* cho phép ủng hộ nguyên tắc truy cập mở và xử lý ngoại lệ riêng. Phân biệt *research findings* với *raw datasets* để lập luận chính xác. Dùng ví dụ người đọc ngoài trường đại học để chứng minh lợi ích xã hội.

title: IELTS Writing Task 2 – Nhà ở thích ứng ngập lụt
prompt:
As some towns face more frequent flooding, governments must decide whether to strengthen existing neighborhoods or encourage residents to move to safer areas. Discuss the advantages of both approaches and give your opinion.

Write at least 250 words.

Yêu cầu: So sánh phương án cải tạo và di dời, có tiêu chí lựa chọn rõ.
sample_answer:
Flood-prone towns face difficult decisions about the future of their residential areas. Improving existing neighborhoods can help preserve communities, while relocation may offer greater long-term protection in places exposed to serious danger. I believe authorities should assess local conditions and involve residents before choosing either approach.

Strengthening existing neighborhoods has several advantages. Better drainage, raised electrical systems and carefully designed flood barriers may reduce damage from some events. These improvements can allow families to remain close to their workplaces, schools and relatives. Staying in place is especially important for residents whose income depends on nearby customers or whose social networks provide childcare and other support. In addition, upgrading roads and public facilities can benefit the entire neighborhood during ordinary weather, not only during floods.

Relocation, however, may be more appropriate when repeated flooding makes an area increasingly unsafe. Building protective infrastructure can be costly, and it may provide limited security in the most exposed locations. Moving households to safer ground could reduce the need for emergency evacuations and repeated repairs. Planned relocation also gives authorities an opportunity to design housing with reliable access to transport, clinics and schools from the beginning.

Despite these benefits, relocation can create serious social and financial problems if it is handled poorly. Compensation may be insufficient to cover a suitable home, and families may lose customers or community connections. Governments should therefore publish risk assessments, discuss options with residents and offer independent advice before major decisions are made. Where protection is feasible, targeted improvements may be preferable. Where risks remain unacceptable, relocation should include fair support for housing, livelihoods and essential services.

In conclusion, both flood protection and relocation can reduce harm, but their suitability depends on local risks and people's needs. Transparent assessment and meaningful public participation should guide the decision rather than a single policy for every community.
tips_md: **IELTS Discuss Advantages – So sánh theo tiêu chí:** Đối chiếu lợi ích duy trì sinh kế với giảm rủi ro dài hạn. Nêu tiêu chí chọn phương án là mức độ nguy hiểm, hiệu quả công trình, chi phí xã hội. Cụm *risk assessment*, *livelihoods* và *meaningful participation* làm rõ tính thực tế.
